decisions.reason: Because it remained on the website through 2024 as an extension of a popular biodynamic range, its observed performance likely meets a satisfactory aspiration level and the firm has little reason to reallocate resources away from it.
As a 2024 launch with its own page, it appears to have enough initial support to stay on the market while the firm uses available slack to learn about demand before judging it below aspiration.

Although still early and somewhat uncertain like many new dairy line extensions, its dedicated 2024 presentation suggests the firm will likely keep it for another year unless results clearly fall short of aspirations.
